prompt: Please generate an image. Locked painterly style: hand-painted stylized game art, chunky readable shapes, detail painted not modelled, mid-level detail, softer muted colours with gentle saturation, epic and luminous, never grim. The palette's warm gold and cool teal are painted into the surfaces, but the light is flat, even studio light: no strong key light, no cast shadows, no rim light. Use the attached images only as reference as described: the first attachment is always the style reference for palette and brushwork; later attachments are the approved designs to keep. Game-asset reference sheet for 3D modelling, wide landscape 16:9. Plain light neutral grey background, no scene, no sky, no clouds, no floating rock, no ground plane, a soft contact shadow only. Every piece fully isolated with clear space around it, nothing overlapping, nothing touching the edge, arranged in tidy rows, each with a small neat hand-lettered label underneath. MODULAR KIT PIECES sheet: Redraw of the attached reference sheet to the current spec: keep exactly the same design, items, their order and names. Modular ship kit sheet 4, deck fittings, reusable deck equipment for skiff, cutter and galleon, in wood with gold fittings, terracotta-red and teal accents, in the same arrangement as the second attached image. Top row: "Ship's wheel (helm)", "Tiller (smaller ships)", "Sailmaster's trim station (sail control & wind gauge)" with levers and a glowing teal wind gauge, "Capstan (hauling & lifting)", "Anchor & chain (mooring)" with chunky chain links. Middle row: "Cargo hatch (hold access)", "Crates & barrels (cargo, lashed)" with nets as thick painted rope, "Deck lanterns (wall / post / hanging)", "Railing segments (straight / corner)". Bottom row: "Gangplank (boarding)", "Boarding hooks (boarding & grappling)", "Ballista (bolt thrower)" of wood and rope, "Spell-focus brazier (sail enchanting)" with teal flame. Labels give the name only, no dimensions, except "1.8 m" on the scale figure at the bottom left standing at true scale to the pieces. Glow only in lanterns, the wind gauge and the brazier flame. Thick solid rope, chunky shapes, even flat light, no rim light. Show each piece as an orthographic front elevation (no perspective) with a small three-quarter view beside it, on faint module grid lines, with its name and size (for example "3 x 4 m") in the label. Thick, solid forms, no thin parts. A plain neutral 1.8 m human silhouette labelled "1.8 m" stands on the sheet for scale, with everything at true scale to it. Title at the top: "Modular ship kit 4 – deck fittings".
